description.value: A well-run private campground on Hwy 20 in Hagensborg, set along the Bella Coola River with a river viewing deck and snow-capped mountain backdrops; flush toilets, showers, and Wi-Fi make it one of the best-equipped stops in the valley. Seasonal only — open late May to mid-October.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at riprapcamp.com is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information for both RV/Tent Sites and Cabins. Key evidence for amenities comes from the RV & Tent Sites subpage, which lists a shower house, covered BBQ area, Wi-Fi, firepits, and proximity to a supermarket. The contact page confirms the phone number matches OSM and gives a fuller address (#1854 Hwy 20, Hagensborg, BC V0T 1H0) — Highway 20 and the Chilcotin Highway are the same road, so addresses agree. The OSM name 'Rip Rap Campsite' differs slightly from the website's consistent branding as 'Rip Rap Camp'.
concerns: OSM name is 'Rip Rap Campsite' but the website consistently uses 'Rip Rap Camp' — minor name discrepancy.
OSM street listed as 'Chilcotin Highway'; website uses 'Hwy 20' (the same road). Website provides a fuller address including Hagensborg, BC V0T 1H0.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-appointed campsite with showers, covered shelter, nearby food, and reservations in a remote but popular BC touring corridor near the BC Ferries terminal — a clear benefit to touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: flush toilets, showers, and Wi-Fi make it one of the best-equipped stops in the valley
